beats: Parents and kids could chat inside the app, but an actual call meant leaving for a different app entirely — and losing the history.
Now calls ring and connect right inside the same app, voice or video.
A WebRTC layer handles the ringing, signaling and handoff behind the scenes.
Every call gets logged too, so the history that used to vanish now stays.
And it survives a 30-second dead spot in the network without ever dropping.
